description: This CSS file contains styles, CSS variables, and media queries for theming and layout of a front-end application, providing both light and dark theme options.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application container with center-aligned text and a dynamic background color based on the selected theme.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Logo container for the app with specific height and pointer events disabled.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header section of the application with a flexible layout and themed background color.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styled link with a theme-based color that changes on hover.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button for toggling themes with specific positioning, styling, and hover states.
